roles.title: Senior Product Designer · Developer Platform
bullets: Design the CLI and dashboard for Helio's deployment platform. Worked alongside 2 PMs and 9 engineers shipping to ~40k weekly active developers.

Built and maintain the design system. 38 components in Figma, mirrored in a Tailwind library that engineering uses directly. Wrote the migration guide that took the team from inline styles to tokens in two weeks.
Run weekly user research sessions. Talked to 80+ developers in the last year. Findings shape the roadmap quarterly.
Wrote and designed the v2 docs site. Reduced time-to-first-deploy from 14 minutes to 5 minutes (measured by event).

roles.title: Product Designer
bullets: First designer at Pendle, an analytics tool for indie SaaS founders. Built the product from a Figma prototype to a paying SaaS with 1,200+ customers.
Designed the dashboard, the onboarding, the billing surface, and the public marketing site. Wrote most of the in-product copy.
Set up the design system from scratch. Shipped a component library in Tailwind that the founder (engineering) could extend without me.

roles.title: Product Designer
bullets: Designed across 6 client projects spanning fintech, B2B SaaS, and e-commerce. Led design on 3 of them as the only designer on the project.
Shipped the redesign of a real-time trading dashboard for a fintech client. Reduced support tickets about the chart UI by half in the first quarter post-launch.
Mentored two junior designers through the project lifecycle. Both are now mid-level at other companies.
